title: Theme studio on the website
summary: A user-guide page where a person starts from a built-in theme or their own file, edits every field of a launcher theme with a live preview drawn by the site's instrument components, sees contrast hints, and downloads a JSON file the launcher reads.

included: Built-in themes exported from the Rust catalog to web/src/data/themes.generated.json, guarded by a lumilio-ui test
Theme studio page in both languages under docs/guide, full width
Editing: presets, import, several themes per file, colours (picker and hex with opacity), radii, fonts, window background, source
Preview with the site's instrument components re-coloured through scoped CSS variables
Validation with the launcher's rules, contrast hints, JSON download and copy, a local draft
Shared instrument and font stylesheets split out of global.css; a guard that tokens.css matches the built-in themes
excluded: Rendering the real launcher in the browser
Uploading or sharing themes through the website
Launcher changes to the theme format

tasks.title: Export built-in themes for the website
tasks.acceptance: A lumilio-ui test fails when web/src/data/themes.generated.json differs from the built-in catalog, and LUMILIO_BLESS_THEMES=1 rewrites it; the file lists colour keys in launcher order

tasks.title: Theme model in TypeScript with launcher parity
tasks.acceptance: vitest covers colour parsing, radius clamping, file parsing of every built-in theme, export round trip, launcher-ignored themes, and contrast ratios

tasks.title: Studio page: editor, preview, download
tasks.acceptance: Both language pages build; a person can start from a preset or import a file, edit every field, see the preview change, and download or copy a file that parses with the launcher's rules

tasks.title: Shared styles and token guard
tasks.acceptance: The marketing page keeps its styles; the studio imports only fonts and instrument styles; a test fails when tokens.css differs from Aluminium or Night

tasks.title: Review on desktop and mobile
tasks.acceptance: The Project Maintainer checks the studio at desktop and phone widths and loads a downloaded theme in the launcher

validation.criterion: Model parity and export tests pass
A downloaded theme loads in the launcher

decisions.decision: The studio is a full-width page in the user guide, not a separate site page
decisions.rationale: It inherits the documentation's language switch, search and navigation, next to the Themes page that explains the file.
decisions.consequences: The page uses Starlight's splash template; its text lives in web/src/i18n/studio.ts.

decisions.decision: Built-in theme values come from Rust through a generated file, never copied by hand
decisions.rationale: The launcher's catalog is the source of truth; a copy would drift as tokens.css already can.
decisions.consequences: Changing a built-in theme requires refreshing the generated file, which the lumilio-ui test enforces.

decisions.decision: The preview re-colours the site's own instrument components instead of drawing a separate mock
decisions.rationale: The marketing page already draws keys, LEDs and displays after the launcher's design language from CSS variables; setting those variables on the preview gives the same look from one stylesheet.
decisions.consequences: Instrument styles move to a shared stylesheet. The preview is representative, not pixel-identical to the launcher.

roadmap.name: Theme studio
